idea-plugin.name: Agent Context
idea-plugin.description: Agent Context inserts a file reference into the selected Reworked Terminal tab in Rider, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, and other IntelliJ Platform IDEs. Press Command plus apostrophe to insert the current file path. A selection adds an inclusive line range, such as src/Foo.cs:44-46. Without a selection, the reference includes the caret line. When the editor has no focus, it includes the current open file without a line number. The file is saved before insertion. By default, focus moves to the terminal; this can be changed under Settings, Tools, Agent Context. Requires IDE version 2025.3 or newer with the Terminal plugin enabled and Reworked Terminal selected. If the shortcut is already assigned, choose another for Add File Reference to Agent Context under Settings, Keymap.

action.text: Add File Reference to Agent Context
action.description: Insert the selected lines, caret line, or open file into the active terminal
